You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From b8c77fcd0774e0c1ecf0451c4faaa4de08359ee6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Anthony G. Basile" <blueness@gentoo.org>
Date: Thu, 4 Apr 2013 20:10:56 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] src/udev/udev-rules.c: fix bug introduced in our 601c4e8

This error was introduced in our commit

    601c4e8ce69338652b3c9178386cbc05de8bae8d

when importing from upstream.  The revert line works only
in the context of all of upstream's commit

    7850b3b83791ba0e2377ba40383c5abc258b839d

Signed-off-by: Anthony G. Basile <blueness@gentoo.org>
Signed-off-by: Ian Stakenvicius <axs@gentoo.org>
---
 src/udev/udev-rules.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/udev/udev-rules.c b/src/udev/udev-rules.c
index 0561e0156..5e56c2f7a 100644
--- a/src/udev/udev-rules.c
+++ b/src/udev/udev-rules.c
@@ -1624,7 +1624,7 @@ struct udev_rules *udev_rules_new(struct udev *udev, int resolve_names)
                 return udev_rules_unref(rules);
         udev_rules_check_timestamp(rules);
 
-        r = conf_files_list_strv(&files, ".rules", NULL, (const char **)rules->dirs);
+        r = conf_files_list_strv(&files, NULL, ".rules", (const char **)rules->dirs);
         if (r < 0) {
                 log_error("failed to enumerate rules files: %s\n", strerror(-r));
                 return udev_rules_unref(rules);
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect argument order in the function call to `conf_files_list_strv`. The original code passed `".rules"` as the second argument, which likely led to incorrect behavior when enumerating rules files. The patch corrects this by changing the order of the arguments, passing `NULL` as the second argument and `".rules"` as the third, aligning with the expected function signature and restoring the intended functionality.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect argument order in the function call to `conf_files_list_strv`. The original code passed `".rules"` as the second argument, which likely led to incorrect behavior when enumerating rules files. The patch corrects this by changing the order of the arguments, passing `NULL` as the second argument and `".rules"` as the third, aligning with the expected function signature and restoring the intended functionality.
